package.name: control_loop
package.description: Closed-loop nodes for the sim-to-real Franka demo (REQ-S2R-002..005): seeded noise injector, causal DSP filter node, and joint-space waypoint controller. All control logic lives in pure-Python modules under control_loop/logic/ (unit-testable without ROS); the rclpy nodes are thin wrappers around them.
